7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1. Documented policies and procedures guide all research activities in compliance with national and international guidelines.

7.2. The organization has an ethics committee to oversee all research activities.

7.3. The committee has the power to discontinue a research trial when risks outweigh the potential benefits.

7.4. Patient’s informed consent is obtained before entering them in research protocols.

7.5. Patients are informed of their right to withdraw from the research at any stage and also of the consequences (if any) of such withdrawal.

7.6. Patients are assured that their refusal to participate or withdrawal from participation will not compromise their access to the organization’s services.

8. 0 PROCESSES

8.1 Any research undertaken in the hospital falls under its ambit. This includes both funded and non-funded and also student studies. The Ethical Guidelines committee will provide IEC clearance to researchers according to standard protocol for research. [Ref. Manual of Research activities].

8.2 We have a university ethical committee which has a hospital representative.

8.3 The committee has the power to discontinue a research trial when risks outweigh the potential benefits.

8.4 The patient's informed consent is obtained in the local language that the patient understands.

8.5 Patients are informed of their right to withdraw from the research at any stage and also of the consequences (if any) of such withdrawal. 8.6 Patients are assured that their refusal to participate or withdrawal from participation will not compromise their access to the hospital services.
